test_title: PYST 36 - SSC CHSL 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 26 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A train takes 36 seconds to pass a man walking at 2 m/s in the same direction and 48 seconds to cross a platform whose length is 50% more than the train. A 60-metre-long tractor is coming from the opposite direction at 6 m/s. Find the time taken by the train to completely cross the tractor. (in approx.)
solution:
**Given:**

Man speed = 2 m/s

Time to pass man = 36 sec

Platform length = 50% more than train

Time to cross platform = 48 sec

Tractor length = 60 m

Tractor speed = 6 m/s (opposite)

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculations:**

Let train speed = v, length = L

⇒ Passing man:

L = (v − 2) × 36

⇒ Crossing platform:

Platform = 1.5L

Total distance = L + 1.5L = 2.5L

⇒ 2.5L = v × 48

Now substitute L:

⇒ 2.5(v − 2) × 36 = v × 48

⇒ 90(v − 2) = 48v

⇒ 90v − 180 = 48v

⇒ 42v = 180

⇒ v = 4.285 m/s

⇒ L = (4.285 − 2) × 36 = 2.285 × 36 ≈ 82.26 m

Now crossing tractor:

Relative speed = 4.285 + 6 = 10.285 m/s

Total length = 82.26 + 60 = 142.26 m

⇒ Time = 142.26 ÷ 10.285 ≈ 13.83 sec

**∴ Time ≈ 14 seconds**
